Messages.Author: mjvtes521
Messages.Body:
How much pool do you gain to burn an ally that cost x blood? For example, if you have a reanimated corpse at superior thanatosis that your vampire paid 2 blood to bring into play with 4 pathos counters on it, how much do you get from burning it with Khobar Towers? I assume 2, but just making sure, since "the blood or pool cost of that ally" is variable.

What if that vampire had ankara citadel or Charisma? Meaning that vampire only had to pay 1 (if they had one of those) or 0 blood (if they had both)? Then do you still get 2 pool when you use Khobar Towers, or do you get 1 or 0? Sorry if somebody asked this already, but I couldn't find it. Here are the relevant card texts:

Khobar Towers, Al-Khubar
Master
Follower of Set
[2 Pool]

Master: unique location.
Tap during your untap phase to remove a ready minion you control from the game and gain X pool, where X is the capacity of that vampire or the blood or pool cost of that ally.

Reanimated Corpse
Ally
[Thanatosis]

[X Blood]

Zombie with 2 life. 2 strength, 2 bleed.
[thn] Put X pathos counters on this corpse when it enters play. During your untap phase, burn 1 pathos counter. Remove the corpse from the game if it has no pathos counters. The corpse can play combat cards that require basic Fortitude [for] as a vampire.
[THN] As above, but put 2 additional pathos counters on the corpse.

Ankara Citadel, Turkey, The
Equipment
Tremere

[2 Blood]

This equipment card represents a location and does not count as equipment while in play. Unique.
Cards that cost blood cost this vampire half as much blood to play (round down).

Charisma
Master

Unique master.
Put this card on a ready vampire. This vampire's recruit ally actions cost 1 less blood or pool (but never less than 0 blood or pool).

Messages.Author: mjvtes521

Another question I forgot to ask (to Vincent/Ankha):

If Mata Hari has Ankara, Superior Thanatosis (from Infernal Pact) and Charisma, how much would she pay for a Reanimated Corpse where x=7? Which do you apply first, Ankara or Charisma?

If Ankara first, then it costs 3 (half of 7 rounded down) -1 (for Charisma) = 2
If Charisma first, then it costs 7 - 1 (for Charisma) =6 divided by 2 (Ankara) = 3

I assume you get to choose, meaning I'd choose the first one, to make it cost 2. Also, if you follow 3rd grade math (PEMDAS), then you divide before subtracting, so it would also cost 2.

Card texts were in the original post above, so save your petty arguments for your own posts. Thanks.

Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body: Ankara is always counted first. This means a 3 cost minion, when paid for with SH, is free, if the minion playing SH has charisma
